mentions.name: Desktop Colemak typing trainer
mentions.description: This desktop program is a typing trainer that merges aspects of MonkeyType, Keyzen-Colemak and Colemak Academy to help learn the Colemak keyboard layout. It was built to give the author a personal tool for practicing the new layout after switching to a split ergonomic keyboard to manage RSI from programming, and also as an experiment in vibe coding an application from scratch.
mentions.problem: Existing online resources for learning the Colemak layout each had strengths but none did everything the author wanted, and RSI from programming motivated the switch to a split ergonomic keyboard and the Colemak-DH layout.
mentions.audience: Existing online resources for learning the Colemak layout each had strengths but none did everything the author wanted, and RSI from programming motivated the switch to a split ergonomic keyboard and the Colemak-DH layout.
